information_coefficient.note: Near zero means the forecast carries no information about realised factor returns. That is a result, not a bug, and it is reported rather than omitted.

accuracy.interpretation: Directional hit rate 68.1% over 304 sleeve-months. Information coefficient +0.058 (n=366).

how_to_read.forecast: T+1 expected values from the optimiser's own decayed trailing window. No outcome month is an input.
how_to_read.accuracy: Directional hit rate 68.1% over 304 sleeve-months. Information coefficient +0.058 (n=366).
how_to_read.suppression_rule: Any accuracy measure with too few observations is reported as null with the count that blocked it, rather than as a number computed from a handful of months.

decision_protocol.signal_date: Last completed trading day of the signal month
decision_protocol.information_cutoff: All inputs must be available by this timestamp
decision_protocol.description: Every model output carries signal_date, information_cutoff, and execution_date to make the point-in-time protocol explicit.
